Import entomological hut trial data

import_ento_data.Rd

Universal import function that reads entomologica data from CSV or Excel files and returns a standardized tibble with appropriate data types.

Usage

import_ento_data(
  file_path,
  required_vars = c("UA", "UD", "FA", "FD", "treatment"),
  treatment_var = "treatment",
  product_var = NULL,
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

file_path

Character. Path to the data file.

required_vars

Character vector. Required columns to check. "treatment" is replaced by treatment_var, which is always required.

treatment_var

Character. Name of the treatment column in the file (case-insensitive). It is renamed to treatment, the name used by format_eht_data and the model functions.

product_var

Character or NULL. Name of the column with the vector control product names (case-insensitive). If given, it is required and renamed to vector_control_product, which the extract functions use to label results. If NULL (default), no product column is required.

quiet

Logical. If FALSE, print import status.

Value

A tibble with standardized column names and data types.

  • Endpoints (ua, ud, fa, fd) are numeric.

  • Treatment variable: renamed to treatment, values preserved as-is

  • Product variable (if product_var is given): renamed to vector_control_product, values preserved as-is

  • Other variables: preserved as-is

Details

The import function:

  • Validates file integrity

  • Reads data with appropriate reader function

  • Converts to tibble format

  • Standardizes column names to lowercase

  • Renames the treatment column to treatment

  • Renames the product column to vector_control_product (if product_var is given)

  • Coerces endpoints to numeric

  • Returns as tibble

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Import CSV file
data <- import_ento_data("ITN_data.csv")

# Import Excel file
data <- import_ento_data("trial_data.xlsx")

# Treatment stored in a column called "Intervention"
data <- import_ento_data("trial_data.csv", treatment_var = "Intervention")

# Treatment codes in "arm", product names in "net_name"
data <- import_ento_data("trial_data.csv",
  treatment_var = "arm", product_var = "net_name")
} # }
